title: Reports
subtitle: Reports are generated in the background and stored securely for a limited time. Every download is audited.

daily_attendance.name: Daily Report
daily_attendance.description: Every employee on one day, grouped by department: attendance code, IN/OUT, worked, base and overtime hours.

monthly_attendance.name: Monthly Attendance Report
monthly_attendance.description: Employees by days of the month with the attendance code in every cell and an absence count.

employee_attendance.name: Detail Report
employee_attendance.description: One page per employee: every day of the period with times, hours, overtime, under time and remarks.

late_report.name: Staff Late Attendance Report
late_report.description: Per department: each employee’s late days of the period and how many.

absence_report.name: Staff Absents Monthly Report
absence_report.description: Per department: each employee’s absent days of the period and how many.

overtime_report.name: Overtime
overtime_report.description: Overtime minutes by category per employee.

missing_punch_report.name: Missed Punch Report
missing_punch_report.description: Every unpaired punch of the period, by date and department, with the time that was recorded.

device_sync_report.name: Device synchronisation
device_sync_report.description: Sync jobs, failures and ingested records per device.

device_health_report.name: Device health
device_health_report.description: Connection status, heartbeats and offline periods per device.

audit_report.name: Audit Trail Report
audit_report.description: Who changed what: attendance edits with old and new values, or the full audit log for the period.

employee_directory.name: Employees Report
employee_directory.description: Employees by department with card number, hire date, designation, status, shift and attendance policy.

leave_report.name: Staff Leave Report
leave_report.description: Per department: each employee’s days of one leave type in the period and how many.

attendance_summary.name: Summary Report
attendance_summary.description: One row per employee for the period: days per attendance code grouped into present, leave and absent totals, with OT1, OT2 and under time.

weekly_attendance.name: Weekly Report
weekly_attendance.description: The week containing the chosen date: first IN and last OUT per employee per day.

weekly_in_out.name: Weekly In/Out Report
weekly_in_out.description: The week containing the chosen date: IN over OUT for each day, or the attendance code when there were no punches.

request.title: Request a report
request.hint: Pick a report type, set its parameters and queue it. You are notified when it is ready.
request.pickType: Select a report type to set its parameters.
request.notAllowed: You lack the permissions for this report.
request.toBeforeFrom: Must be on or after the start date
request.reasonHint: Some organisations require a reason for exports; it is stored in the audit log.
request.queuedHint: It appears below and refreshes automatically until it is ready.

list.title: My reports
list.cancelHint: Only queued reports can be cancelled.
list.linkExpires: The link is valid for {{seconds}} seconds.
list.emptyHint: Requested reports appear here with their status; completed files can be downloaded until they expire.
